caption: The drawing depicts an object that appears to be an old-fashioned lamp or lantern, predominantly brown in color with various shades for depth and contrast. The main body is cylindrical with a rounded, slightly conical top, adorned by a scalloped edge. Attached to the main cylinder is a large, prominent lens or light source on one side, projecting outward and slightly downward. There is a handle attached to the side, curving outward and upward, and another handle or lever protruding from the back at an upward angle. A strap, possibly leather, loops from one side and hangs loosely. The overall composition is centered, with the object rendered in realistic detail and shading on a plain, light background. The artist's signature, "ALEXANDER ANDERSON.1933," is visible in small letters at the bottom right.
title: Police Lantern and Club
